ImageDescription.value:
Himantopus himantopus at Osman Sagar, Telangana, India.
I had very little editing to do in the picture except for cropping. The lake was almost dry and buzzing with activity. Many birds are busy digging up the wet slushy mud for food. And these stilts were in the right angle for me to get this shot!
Thanks for your views / feedback. Please stay safe and healthy.
